title: Pin HOME, XDG, and SUSI_HOME in susi-gmcp binary test EnvGuard
goal: Override HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, and SUSI_HOME on EnvGuard::isolated() in crates/susi-gmcp/src/main.rs unit tests so cargo test --workspace without an outer SUSI_HOME swap never falls back to real ~/.susi/reflexes/unregistered_tool_xyz.{rs,wasm}.
